name: neuralscape
description: Persistent agentic memory for Claude Code and Claude Cowork. Multi-user support: each user has personal memory (only they can read it) plus access to a shared team knowledge pool. In Claude Code, plugin hooks auto-capture conversations + per-tool observations and recall context on session start; in Claude Cowork (which does not run plugin hooks), the cross-platform recall/remember/save-session/project skills drive the same loop through the MCP connector. Exposes 8 MCP tools (recall_memories, remember, remember_conversation, get_project_context, search_knowledge_graph, list_memories, list_projects, delete_memories).

URL.title: Neuralscape service URL
URL.description: Base URL of your Neuralscape API (e.g. https://neuralscape.example.com or http://localhost:8199).

API_KEY.title: Bearer token (per-user) or legacy shared API key
API_KEY.description: For multi-user deployments, this is your per-user token issued by the admin via `scripts/issue_user_token.py --user <name>`. The token encodes your user_id; the server reads it from the token, not from the body. For legacy single-user deployments, this is the shared NEURALSCAPE_API_KEY. Leave empty for local dev.

USER_ID.title: Your user ID
USER_ID.description: Stable identifier used to scope memories to you. When using a per-user token, this must match the user_id encoded in the token (or be left empty — the token wins). Required for legacy shared-key auth.

COMPILE_THRESHOLD.title: Compile threshold (observations)
COMPILE_THRESHOLD.description: Buffer size that triggers in-session compilation via UserPromptSubmit. Default: 25.

COMPILE_AGE_MIN.title: Compile age (minutes)
COMPILE_AGE_MIN.description: Buffer age (oldest entry) that triggers in-session compilation. Default: 30.
